quranTranslation.text: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.

explanation.bs: Sigurnost od straha: خَوْف kao suprotnost sigurnosti.
explanation.en: Security from fear: khawf as the opposite of safety.

quranTranslation.text: And surely We shall try you with something of fear and hunger, and loss of wealth and lives and crops; but give glad tidings to the steadfast,

explanation.bs: Iskušenje strahom i glađu – strah od ovosvjetskih nedaća.
explanation.en: A trial of fear and hunger — fear of worldly hardship.

quranTranslation.text: We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

explanation.bs: „Za njih nema straha“ – opća riječ, zanijekana u cijelosti.
explanation.en: “There shall no fear come upon them” — the general word, negated entirely.

quranTranslation.text: If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect.

explanation.bs: Brdo bi se rascijepilo od strahopoštovanja prema Allahu – strah koji dolazi uz spoznaju Njegove veličine.
explanation.en: A mountain would split from awe of Allah — fear that comes with knowing His greatness.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.

explanation.bs: Vjernici zabrinuti iz strahopoštovanja prema svome Gospodaru.
explanation.en: Believers apprehensive out of awe of their Lord.

quranTranslation.text: Slay not your children, fearing a fall to poverty, We shall provide for them and for you. Lo! the slaying of them is great sin.

explanation.bs: „Iz straha od siromaštva“ – iznimka: خَشْيَة i za strah od same nevolje.
explanation.en: “Fearing a fall to poverty” — the exception: khashya also for fear of the hardship itself.

quranTranslation.text: And (unto man): O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden and eat from whence ye will, but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „Pa jedite odakle god želite, i ne prilazite ovom drvetu“ – jelo u doslovnom smislu.
explanation.en: “Eat from whence ye will, but come not nigh this tree” — eating in the literal sense.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Those who devour the wealth of orphans wrongfully, they do but swallow fire into their bellies, and they will be exposed to burning flame.

explanation.bs: Oni koji nepravedno jedu imetke siročadi, oni u trbuhe svoje vatru trpaju – preneseno značenje.
explanation.en: Those who devour the property of orphans unjustly are only consuming fire into their bellies — the figurative sense.

quranTranslation.text: Saying: O our father! We went racing one with another, and left Joseph by our things, and the wolf devoured him, and thou believest not our saying even when we speak the truth.

explanation.bs: „Pa ga je pojeo vuk“ – kažu Jusufova braća.
explanation.en: “And the wolf devoured him” — say Joseph's brothers.

quranTranslation.text: And when Saul set out with the army, he said: Lo! Allah will try you by (the ordeal of) a river. Whosoever therefore drinketh thereof he is not of me, and whosoever tasteth it not he is of me, save him who taketh (thereof) in the hollow of his hand. But they drank thereof, all save a few of them. And after he had crossed (the river), he and those who believed with him, they said: We have no power this day against Goliath and his hosts. But those who knew that they would meet Allah exclaimed: How many a little company hath overcome a mighty host by Allah's leave! Allah is with the steadfast.

explanation.bs: „A ko je i ne okusi, on pripada meni“ – Talutova vojska i rijeka: طَعِمَ za vodu.
explanation.en: “Whosoever tasteth it not he is of me” — Saul's army and the river: طَعِمَ of water.

quranTranslation.text: O Ye who believe! Enter not the dwellings of the Prophet for a meal without waiting for the proper time, unless permission be granted you. But if ye are invited, enter, and, when your meal is ended, then disperse. Linger not for conversation. Lo! that would cause annoyance to the Prophet, and he would be shy of (asking) you (to go); but Allah is not shy of the truth. And when ye ask of them (the wives of the Prophet) anything, ask it of them from behind a curtain. That is purer for your hearts and for their hearts. And it is not for you to cause annoyance to the messenger of Allah, nor that ye should ever marry his wives after him. Lo! that in Allah's sight would be an enormity.

explanation.bs: „A kad pojedete, raziđite se“ – gosti u Poslanikovoj kući.
explanation.en: “When your meal is ended, then disperse” — guests in the Prophet's house.

quranTranslation.text: There shall be no sin (imputed) unto those who believe and do good works for what they may have eaten (in the past). So be mindful of your duty (to Allah), and believe, and do good works; and again: be mindful of your duty, and believe; and once again: be mindful of your duty, and do right. Allah loveth the good.

explanation.bs: Nema grijeha vjernicima u onome što su ranije uzimali – tefsir: vino prije zabrane; طَعِمَ i za piće.
explanation.en: No blame on the believers for what they consumed before — tafsir: wine before its prohibition; طَعِمَ for drink too.

quranTranslation.text: That which Allah giveth as spoil unto His messenger from the people of the townships, it is for Allah and His messenger and for the near of kin and the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, that it become not a commodity between the rich among you. And whatsoever the messenger giveth you, take it. And whatsoever he forbiddeth, abstain (from it). And keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is stern in reprisal.

explanation.bs: „A od onoga što vam on zabrani – suzdržite se“ – zabrana Poslanika.
explanation.en: “Whatsoever he forbiddeth, abstain (from it)” — the Messenger's prohibition.

quranTranslation.text: Then Satan whispered to them that he might manifest unto them that which was hidden from them of their shame, and he said: Your Lord forbade you from this tree only lest ye should become angels or become of the immortals.

explanation.bs: Šejtan: „Gospodar vaš nije vam ovo drvo zabranio ni zbog čega drugog nego da ne postanete meleki…“ – zabrana upućena Ademu i njegovoj ženi.
explanation.en: Satan: “Your Lord forbade you from this tree only lest ye should become angels…” — a prohibition addressed to Adam and his wife.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth

explanation.bs: Onaj ko zabranjuje – čak i robu dok klanja (96:10) – نَهَى i za zlu zabranu.
explanation.en: The one who forbids — even a servant at prayer (96:10) — نَهَى for a wicked prohibition too.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Who hath forbidden the adornment of Allah which He hath brought forth for His bondmen, and the good things of His providing? Say: Such, on the Day of Resurrection, will be only for those who believed during the life of the world. Thus do we detail Our revelations for people who have knowledge.

explanation.bs: „Reci: Ko je zabranio Allahov ukras…?“ – ukor onima koji haramom proglašavaju bez prava.
explanation.en: “Say: Who hath forbidden the adornment of Allah…?” — reproach for declaring things unlawful without right.

quranTranslation.text: And We had before forbidden foster-mothers for him, so she said: Shall I show you a household who will rear him for you and take care of him?

explanation.bs: „I Mi smo mu ranije uskratili dojilje“ – taḥrīm kao Allahova odredba, ne propis.
explanation.en: “We had before forbidden foster-mothers for him” — taḥrīm as Allah's decree, not a law.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Come, I will recite unto you that which your Lord hath made a sacred duty for you: That ye ascribe no thing as partner unto Him and that ye do good to parents, and that ye slay not your children because of penury - We provide for you and for them - and that ye draw not nigh to lewd things whether open or concealed. And that ye slay not the life which Allah hath made sacred, save in the course of justice. This He hath command you, in order that ye may discern.

explanation.bs: „Dođite da vam proučim šta vam je vaš Gospodar zabranio“ – haram kao propis.
explanation.en: The call to come and hear what your Lord has made unlawful for you (حَرَّمَ) — ḥarām as a ruling.

quranTranslation.text: Allah is the Protecting Guardian of those who believe. He bringeth them out of darkness into light. As for those who disbelieve, their patrons are false deities. They bring them out of light into darkness. Such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.

explanation.bs: „Allah je zaštitnik onih koji vjeruju, On ih izvodi iz tmina na svjetlost“ – Allahova briga o vjernicima.
explanation.en: “Allah is the Protecting Guardian of those who believe. He bringeth them out of darkness into light” — Allah's care for the believers.

quranTranslation.text: And slay not the life which Allah hath forbidden save with right. Whoso is slain wrongfully, We have given power unto his heir, but let him not commit excess in slaying. Lo! he will be helped.

explanation.bs: Ako neko bude ubijen nepravedno, njegovom bliskom srodniku (وَلِيّ), staratelju njegovog prava, dali smo vlast.
explanation.en: “Whoso is slain wrongfully, We have given power unto his heir” — the heir is the وَلِيّ, the guardian of his right.

quranTranslation.text: Allah knoweth best (who are) your enemies. Allah is sufficient as a Guardian, and Allah is sufficient as a Supporter.

explanation.bs: „Allah je dovoljan kao zaštitnik i Allah je dovoljan kao pomagač.“
explanation.en: “Allah is sufficient as a Guardian, and Allah is sufficient as a Supporter.”

quranTranslation.text: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!

explanation.bs: „Divan li je On Zaštitnik i divan li je Pomagač!“ – مَوْلَى i نَصِير.
explanation.en: “A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!” — مَوْلَى and نَصِير.

quranTranslation.text: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!

explanation.bs: „Zaista, spominjanjem Allaha smiruju se srca!“ – mir srca kroz spominjanje Allaha.
explanation.en: “Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!” — the heart's peace through remembrance.

gloss.en: to be at ease, to be reassured

quranTranslation.text: And when Abraham said (unto his Lord): My Lord! Show me how Thou givest life to the dead, He said: Dost thou not believe? Abraham said: Yea, but (I ask) in order that my heart may be at ease. (His Lord) said: Take four of the birds and cause them to incline unto thee, then place a part of them on each hill, then call them, they will come to thee in haste, and know that Allah is Mighty, Wise.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „Dakako, ali da mi se srce smiri“ – ne iz sumnje (odgovor mu je bio potvrdan), nego radi uvjerenosti viđenjem.
explanation.en: Abraham: “Yea, but (I ask) in order that my heart may be at ease” — not from doubt (his answer was yes), but for the certainty of seeing.

gloss.en: to be at ease, to be reassured

quranTranslation.text: Lo! those who expect not the meeting with Us but desire the life of the world and feel secure therein, and those who are neglectful of Our revelations,

explanation.bs: „…i zadovoljni su ovosvjetskim životom i u njemu se smiruju“ – pokudno smirenje.
explanation.en: “…desire the life of the world and feel secure therein” — a blameworthy ease.

gloss.en: to be at ease, to be reassured

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith. Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knower, Wise -

explanation.bs: „On je Onaj Koji je spustio smirenost u srca vjernika da bi svom vjerovanju još vjerovanja dodali“ – سَكِينَة kao dar.
explanation.en: “He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith” — سَكِينَة as a gift.

quranTranslation.text: If ye help him not, still Allah helped him when those who disbelieve drove him forth, the second of two; when they two were in the cave, when he said unto his comrade: Grieve not. Lo! Allah is with us. Then Allah caused His peace of reassurance to descend upon him and supported him with hosts ye cannot see, and made the word of those who disbelieved the nethermost, while Allah's Word it was that became the uppermost. Allah is Mighty, Wise.

explanation.bs: „…pa Allah spusti na njega Svoju smirenost“ – u pećini, u času najvećeg straha (većina: na Poslanika; neki: na Ebu Bekra).
explanation.en: “Then Allah caused His peace of reassurance to descend upon him” — in the cave, at the hour of greatest fear (most: upon the Prophet; some: upon Abu Bakr).

quranTranslation.text: And their Prophet said unto them: Lo! the token of his kingdom is that there shall come unto you the ark wherein is peace of reassurance from your Lord, and a remnant of that which the house of Moses and the house of Aaron left behind, the angels bearing it. Lo! herein shall be a token for you if (in truth) ye are believers.

explanation.bs: „…kovčeg u kojem je smirenost od vašeg Gospodara“ – tefsir se razilazi šta je ta سَكِينَة bila.
explanation.en: “…the ark wherein is peace of reassurance from your Lord” — tafsir differs on what this سَكِينَة was.

quranTranslation.text: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.

explanation.bs: „I iskušavamo vas zlom i dobrom, kao kušnju (فِتْنَةً)“ – kušnja s obje strane.
explanation.en: “We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal” — trial from both sides.

quranTranslation.text: And know that your possessions and your children are a test, and that with Allah is immense reward.

explanation.bs: „I znajte da su vaši imeci i vaša djeca samo iskušenje“ – zavodljivost blagodati.
explanation.en: “And know that your possessions and your children are a test” — the lure of blessings.

quranTranslation.text: And slay them wherever ye find them, and drive them out of the places whence they drove you out, for persecution is worse than slaughter. And fight not with them at the Inviolable Place of Worship until they first attack you there, but if they attack you (there) then slay them. Such is the reward of disbelievers.

explanation.bs: „…a smutnja (الْفِتْنَةُ) je teža od ubijanja“ – u kontekstu borbe protiv onih koji napadaju (2:190); tefsir: širk ili progon zbog vjere.
explanation.en: “…for persecution [al-fitnah] is worse than slaughter” — in the context of fighting those who fight you (2:190); tafsir: shirk or persecution for the faith.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! that verily was a clear test.

explanation.bs: „Ovo je, zaista, bila očita kušnja“ – Ibrahimovo iskušenje.
explanation.en: “Lo! that verily was a clear test” — Abraham's test.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk, who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaying your sons and sparing your women: that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.

explanation.bs: „…a u tome vam je bila velika kušnja od vašeg Gospodara“ – tefsir: kušnja u patnji ili blagodat u spasu.
explanation.en: “…that was a tremendous trial from your Lord” — tafsir: a trial in the torment, or a favour in the rescue.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when his Lord tried Abraham with (His) commands, and he fulfilled them, He said: Lo! I have appointed thee a leader for mankind. (Abraham) said: And of my offspring (will there be leaders)? He said: My covenant includeth not wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „A kad je Ibrahima njegov Gospodar iskušao riječima (zapovijedima), pa ih je on ispunio…“ – kušnja vjerovjesnika; tefsir se razilazi šta su te riječi bile.
explanation.en: “And (remember) when his Lord tried Abraham with (His) commands, and he fulfilled them…” — a prophet's test; tafsir differs on what they were.

quranTranslation.text: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.

explanation.bs: „A čovjek, kad ga njegov Gospodar iskuša pa ga počasti i obaspe blagodatima…“ – kušnja blagodati.
explanation.en: “As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him…” — the test of blessing.

quranTranslation.text: There were the believers sorely tried, and shaken with a mighty shock.

explanation.bs: „Tu su vjernici bili iskušani i snažno uzdrmani“ – kušnja strahom na Hendeku.
explanation.en: “There were the believers sorely tried, and shaken with a mighty shock” — the trial of fear at the Trench.

quranTranslation.text: And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey.

explanation.bs: Musa svom momku: „Donesi nam naš jutarnji obrok, zaista smo na ovom našem putovanju umor iskusili“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Moses to his boy: “Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: It is not for the townsfolk of Al-Madinah and for those around them of the wandering Arabs so stay behind the messenger of Allah and prefer their lives to his life. That is because neither thirst nor toil nor hunger afflicteth them in the way of Allah, nor step they any step that angereth the disbelievers, nor gain they from the enemy a gain, but a good deed is recorded for them therefor. Lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the good.

explanation.bs: Onima koji izađu na Allahovom putu „ne pogađa ih ni žeđ, ni umor, ni gladovanje“, a da im se to ne upiše kao dobro djelo.
explanation.en: Those who go out in the cause of Allah: “neither thirst nor toil nor hunger afflicteth them”, but that a good deed is recorded for them by it.

quranTranslation.text: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.

explanation.bs: Stanovnici Dženneta: „Umor ih ondje neće dotaći, niti će odande biti istjerani.“
explanation.en: The people of Paradise: “Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.”

quranTranslation.text: Who, of His grace, hath installed us in the mansion of eternity, where toil toucheth us not nor can weariness affect us.

explanation.bs: „… gdje nas ne dotiče umor i gdje nas ne dotiče malaksalost“ – obje riječi zajedno.
explanation.en: “… where toil toucheth us not nor can weariness affect us” — both words together.

quranTranslation.text: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.

explanation.bs: „I doista smo nebesa i Zemlju, i sve što je među njima, stvorili u šest dana, i nije Nas dotakla nikakva malaksalost“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; kako Allahu priliči.
explanation.en: “And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; as befits Allah.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! Eat of that which is lawful and wholesome in the earth, and follow not the footsteps of the devil. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.

explanation.bs: „O ljudi, jedite od onoga što je na zemlji dozvoljeno i lijepo“ – dozvola i dobrota zajedno.
explanation.en: “O mankind! Eat of that which is lawful and wholesome in the earth” — permission and goodness together.

quranTranslation.text: And speak not, concerning that which your own tongues qualify (as clean or unclean), the falsehood: "This is lawful, and this is forbidden," so that ye invent a lie against Allah. Lo! those who invent a lie against Allah will not succeed.

explanation.bs: „I ne govorite o onome što vaši jezici lažno opisuju: ‚Ovo je dozvoljeno, a ovo zabranjeno‘ …“ – dozvola pripada Allahu; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “And speak not, concerning that which your own tongues qualify … the falsehood: This is lawful, and this is forbidden” — permission belongs to Allah; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Have ye considered what provision Allah hath sent down for you, how ye have made of it lawful and unlawful? Hath Allah permitted you, or do ye invent a lie concerning Allah?

explanation.bs: „… pa ste od njega jedno proglasili zabranjenim, a drugo dozvoljenim. Reci: ‚Je li vam Allah dozvolio …‘“ – dozvola koja nije od Allaha.
explanation.en: “How ye have made of it lawful and unlawful? Hath Allah permitted you” — a permission that is not Allah's.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Forbid not the good things which Allah hath made lawful for you, and transgress not, Lo! Allah loveth not transgressors.

explanation.bs: „O vjernici, ne zabranjujte lijepe stvari koje vam je Allah dozvolio“ – طَيِّبَات su ono što je Allah dozvolio; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Forbid not the good things which Allah hath made lawful for you” — the ṭayyibāt are what Allah made lawful; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: As for the good land, its vegetation cometh forth by permission of its Lord; while as for that which is bad, only the useless cometh forth (from it). Thus do We recount the tokens for people who give thanks.

explanation.bs: „A iz lijepe zemlje izlazi njeno bilje s dopuštenjem njenog Gospodara“ – ar-Rāġib kaže: čista zemlja.
explanation.en: “As for the good land, its vegetation cometh forth by permission of its Lord” — ar-Rāġib says: pure land.

quranTranslation.text: Whoso desireth power (should know that) all power belongeth to Allah. Unto Him good words ascend, and the pious deed doth He exalt; but those who plot iniquities, theirs will be an awful doom; and the plotting of such (folk) will come to naught.

explanation.bs: „K Njemu se uzdižu lijepe riječi“ – kako Njemu priliči; طَيِّب i za riječ; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Unto Him good words ascend” — as befits Him; ṭayyib said of speech; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!

explanation.bs: „… oni koji vjeruju i čija srca nalaze smirenost u spominjanju Allaha. Pazite: u spominjanju Allaha srca nalaze smirenost!“
explanation.en: “Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!”

quranTranslation.text: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.

explanation.bs: „Mi smo, uistinu, objavili Opomenu, i Mi ćemo je, zaista, čuvati“ – ḏikr kao ime Kur'ana.
explanation.en: “Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian” — ḏikr as a name of the Quran.

quranTranslation.text: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.

explanation.bs: „I on je, zaista, čast i spomen tebi i tvome narodu …“ – ar-Rāġib ḏikr ovdje objašnjava kao čast; mnogi mufessiri kao opomenu.
explanation.en: “And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk” — ar-Rāġib explains ḏikr here as honour; many mufassirun as a reminder.

quranTranslation.text: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.

explanation.bs: „I podarili smo mu njegove ukućane, a uz njih još toliko isto – milost od Nas i opomenu za one obdarene razumom“ – Ejjub; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding” — Job; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.

explanation.bs: „I podsjećaj, jer podsjećanje vjernicima koristi“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za ḏikrā.
explanation.en: “And warn, for warning [aḏ-ḏikrā] profiteth believers” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for ḏikrā.

quranTranslation.text: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,

explanation.bs: „Nikako! Ovo je, zaista, podsjetnik“ – ar-Rāġib: tj. Kur'an.
explanation.en: “Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment” — ar-Rāġib: that is, the Quran.

quranTranslation.text: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,

explanation.bs: „Pa šta im je da se od podsjetnika okreću?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Why now turn they away from the Admonishment” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
